item.title: Squarespace: Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems
item.description:
Headquarters: New York City; Remote

Squarespace is seeking a talented Staff Software Engineer to support and evolve the systems at the core core of our monetization platform: billing, payments and orders. In this role, you will provide technical oversight over the critical monetization machinery that accepts orders, processes payments and bills subscriptions. You will regularly collaborate with engineering leadership and key product, strategy and finance stakeholders to align technical strategy with Squarespace’s business objectives. This is an opportunity to take on IC technical leadership responsibilities and own system architecture for high-visibility initiatives tied directly to Squarespace's core businesses.

This role is open to remote or hybrid working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the Director of Revenue Systems.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/squarespace-staff-software-engineer-revenue-systems

item.title: Databricks: Deployment Strategist
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Salary range: $150,000 - $180,000 USD. Apply through our Greenhouse board.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/databricks-deployment-strategist
